defects.definition: Canonical appearance evidence does not support the intended visual identity.
A referenced external texture, buffer, or other required payload is absent.
Geometry is degenerate, malformed, empty, or outside bounded processing policy.
Measured support, contact, collision, or interface evidence cannot satisfy the asserted installation contract.
Material inventory or unlit base-color evidence is insufficient to assess the asset.
Measured dimensions or units conflict with the asserted physical contract.
The asserted whole, aggregate, component, attachment, surface, or environment form conflicts with evidence.
Bound rights evidence does not permit the intended catalog use.
The admitted denotation or semantic facets conflict with the reviewed evidence.
The source payload fails format, hash, resource, or bounded-parse integrity.
The asset cannot be shown coherent with the target style from isolated appearance and material evidence.
The two assets cannot satisfy the same support, contact, collision, and interface site.
The two assets do not independently satisfy the same exact semantic site.
The two assets cannot replace each other within the declared geometric and metric envelope.
The two assets are not mutually coherent under the declared style contract.

criteria.definition: Determine whether canonical lit appearance supports the reviewed visual identity.
criteria.passCondition: All canonical views expose a stable, intelligible appearance without lighting artifacts deciding identity.

criteria.definition: Verify that every payload required to render and measure the asset is present.
criteria.passCondition: Every referenced buffer, image, and material payload resolves by exact content hash.

criteria.definition: Assess bounded geometry validity independently from texture and lighting.
criteria.passCondition: Geometry is non-empty, non-degenerate, bounded, and suitable for deterministic measurement.

criteria.definition: Review support, contact, collision, and interface evidence as one installation contract.
criteria.passCondition: The asserted placement signature is directly supported by measured evidence without semantic inference from bounds.

criteria.definition: Separate actual material content from renderer or lighting failures.
criteria.passCondition: Material inventory and unlit base color make all appearance-driving channels inspectable.

criteria.definition: Verify canonical meter scale and dimensional plausibility.
criteria.passCondition: Units and measured extents agree with the asserted physical role and configured bounds.

criteria.definition: Compare whether both assets can occupy the same typed installation site.
criteria.passCondition: Support, contact, interfaces, collision, and clearances are mutually compatible.

criteria.definition: Compare independent satisfaction of one exact semantic site.
criteria.passCondition: Both assets satisfy the same denotation, states, affordances, treatments, realization form, and evidence floor.

criteria.definition: Compare shape and metric substitutability independently from material.
criteria.passCondition: Both assets fit the site envelope and preserve its required occupied-space behavior.

criteria.definition: Compare mutual visual coherence under one style profile.
criteria.passCondition: Either asset can replace the other without violating the site style contract.

criteria.definition: Determine the asset realization form independently of its noun label.
criteria.passCondition: Admitted realization form agrees with composition, connectivity, and multiview shape evidence.

criteria.definition: Verify the exact rights evidence selected for catalog use.
criteria.passCondition: The bound rights record permits every required use and is tied to the exact source bytes.

criteria.definition: Adjudicate denotation and orthogonal semantic facets against the sealed kernel.
criteria.passCondition: Every admitted assertion is supported, exact, internally consistent, and no narrower unsupported claim is made.

criteria.definition: Verify source bytes and bounded format integrity before interpretation.
criteria.passCondition: The exact bytes parse within policy with no malformed, unsupported, or ambiguous resource state.

criteria.definition: Assess style without using denotation, filename, source folder, or vendor origin.
criteria.passCondition: Appearance and material evidence satisfy the declared style profile across canonical views.

strata.definition: Sources whose deterministic integrity and render evidence is complete.
Malformed, unsupported, missing-resource, or visually failed sources.
Components, attachments, surfaces, route pieces, and environment realizers.
Whole or component assets supported primarily from below.
Wall, ceiling, surface, or socket-hosted assets.
Sources with absent, flat, transparent, or otherwise sparse material evidence.
Sources with texture- or vertex-color-driven appearance.
Large structures, terrain pieces, and environment-scale assets.
Small props, trim, and attachment-scale assets.
Cases near a concept, realization, state, affordance, or treatment boundary.
Hard positive and hard negative pairs near a substitution decision boundary.
Independent whole objects and intentional multi-object aggregates.
